readonly.title: You can't write to this folder
readonly.body: The wiki is view-only. Editing, renaming, deleting and saving rules work when the folder is writable.

unavailable.title: The project integration that stores wikis is off
unavailable.body: Wikis are stored in the project folder. Until you turn the integration on, the app doesn't create them in its own store instead.

problem.folderMissing: Can't show the wiki: the project folder wasn't found
problem.manifestInvalid: Can't show the wiki: the project settings file can't be read
problem.configReadonly: Can't edit the wiki: you can't write to this folder
problem.hint: Trying again gives the same result. Check the project folder and its settings. The project's status also shows in the sidebar.

list.emptyBody: A wiki is a set of linked Markdown pages stored in this project folder. Wiki rules can define what to record, and you can create a wiki without rules.

steps.rules: Create wiki rules in the shared library (optional)
steps.attach: In the team, attach the “Wiki” resource to the agent that manages the wiki

newWiki.title: New wiki
newWiki.name: Name
newWiki.rulesHint: Rules are merged from the top down. If you add no rules, the wiki has none.
newWiki.rulesNotChosen_one: You haven't added any of the {count} rule available in this project yet.
newWiki.rulesNotChosen_other: You haven't added any of the {count} rules available in this project yet.
newWiki.rulesNone: This project has no wiki rules. You can create a wiki without rules and add some later on the wiki's Rules tab.
newWiki.rulesFailed: Couldn't load the wiki rule list
newWiki.fromLibraryNone: The shared library has no wiki rules to copy
newWiki.homeHint: If empty, no home page is set
newWiki.importAsk: Already have a folder of Markdown files?

newPage.title: New page
newPage.routeWord: Names ending in “{word}” collide with addresses and can't be read. Use another name.

move.title: Rename or move
move.done_one: Changed the page path ({count} link updated)
move.done_other: Changed the page path ({count} links updated)
move.dirty: Save or discard your changes first

delete.title: Delete page “{title}”
delete.backlinks_one: {count} other page points to this page. Deleting it turns that link into a broken link.
delete.backlinks_other: {count} other pages point to this page. Deleting it turns those links into broken links.
delete.recoverable: The file is deleted. You can restore it from history.
delete.unrecoverable: The file is deleted and can't be restored. This wiki doesn't keep history.

deleteWiki.title: Delete wiki “{name}”
deleteWiki.body: Only the wiki definition is deleted. The page files stay in the {path} folder. If you create a wiki with the same id again, you can continue where you left off.
deleteWiki.bodyNoPath: Only the wiki definition is deleted. The page files stay in the page folder. If you create a wiki with the same id again, you can continue where you left off.
deleteWiki.usage: Resources that point to this wiki fail at run time with a “wiki not found” error.
deleteWiki.done: Deleted the wiki. The page folder is still there

transfer.exportBody: Downloads wiki “{name}” as a zip. Page history isn't included.
transfer.exportBodyPages_one: Downloads wiki “{name}” with {count} page as a zip. Page history isn't included.
transfer.exportBodyPages_other: Downloads wiki “{name}” with {count} pages as a zip. Page history isn't included.
transfer.drop: Drop a zip file here, or
transfer.policy: If a page with the same path exists
transfer.overwriteWarn: The content of pages with the same path is lost. If the wiki keeps history, you can restore it.

page.emptyTitle: This wiki has no pages yet
page.emptyBody: Create the first page with [New page…] in the header, or put Markdown files in the folder and select [Rescan].
page.firstSteps: ① Create a page → ② Link pages to each other → ③ Set the home page under Wiki info on the Rules tab
page.homeMissing: The home page “{home}” doesn't exist yet
page.noneBody: Choose one in the tree on the left, or use content search (/).
page.large: This is a large page. The preview may be slow
page.noSyntaxBody: The link syntax is off or not set, so links between pages aren't looked up. Set the link syntax in the wiki rules or the settings.

editor.insertLinkOff: This syntax has no link insert template. Type the link yourself
editor.discardBody: If you close, your edits to this page are lost.
editor.reloadBody: Your changes are lost and replaced by the latest content on the server.
editor.overwriteBody: Changes made elsewhere are replaced by yours. If the wiki keeps history, the earlier content stays in it.
editor.previewOff: This setup can't run the rule test

band.secretRejected: Couldn't save: something looks like a secret
band.secretRejectedAt: Couldn't save: something looks like a secret (lines {lines})
band.tooLargeLimit: The page is too large (limit {limitKb} KB)
band.externalDirty: This page was changed elsewhere. Saving causes a conflict.
band.secretSuspect_one: Something looks like a secret in {count} place. It was saved.
band.secretSuspect_other: Something looks like a secret in {count} places. It was saved.
band.secretSuspectAt_one: Something looks like a secret in {count} place (lines {lines}). It was saved.
band.secretSuspectAt_other: Something looks like a secret in {count} places (lines {lines}). It was saved.
band.frontMatter: Couldn't read the front matter, so it's shown as content
band.frontMatterAt: Couldn't read the front matter, so it's shown as content (line {line})
band.parseTimeout: Couldn't analyze this page's links (timed out)
band.versionNotFound: That version was removed by the retention limit, or doesn't exist
band.viewingVersion: This is the content as of v{n}
band.readOnlyEdit: You can't write to this folder, so you can't edit. Opened in view mode.

records.notWritten: The history store isn't writable, so this change isn't recorded

side.label: Page info
side.backlinksNone: No links point to this page

history.restoreBody: The current content is kept in the history as a new version.
history.pageGone: This page was deleted. You can restore it from history.

leave.title: You have unsaved changes
leave.body: If you leave this screen, your edits are lost.

codeHints.broken_link: A link whose target page doesn't exist
codeHints.orphan: A page that nothing links to
codeHints.duplicate_title: Two or more pages have the same title

graph.truncatedNoTotal: Only some are shown. Reduce the depth
graph.bigTitle: There are many nodes, so it starts at a size where text is readable. Reduce the center or depth to see it at a glance
graph.bigFallback: There are many pages, so only the area around “{path}” is shown. Change the center to see elsewhere
graph.empty: No pages to draw in the graph
graph.noLinks: This wiki has no links between pages
graph.centerMissing: Page “{path}” doesn't exist, so everything is shown
graph.noSyntaxBody: The link syntax is off or not set, so links between pages aren't looked up. Set the link syntax in the wiki rules or the settings.
graph.schemeNoTarget: This link goes to another feature
graph.createBlocked: Can't create the broken target page

lint.noneEnabled: No checks are on. Add check rules on the Rules tab, or turn on the default checks in the syntax settings.
lint.noSyntax: There's no link syntax, so links aren't checked
lint.openSkipped: Open page that couldn't be checked: {path}

rules.conflictBody: Reloading discards the changes on this screen. Overwriting discards the changes made elsewhere.
rules.readonlyTop: You can't write to this folder, so you can't edit wiki info or rules.
rules.instructionsRunsOff: The runs integration is off, so nothing is passed to agents right now
rules.instructionsNote: Passed on when an agent has the wiki resource attached and “Pass rule instructions” is on. Page content isn't part of the instructions.
rules.syntaxDefault: Package default — you can turn it off in settings

rules.title: Wiki rules

empty.title: No wiki rules
empty.body: Wiki rules define what a wiki records, how it's checked, and what instructions agents get. Create your own. A wiki works without rules.

rules.picked: Choose a rule on the left to edit it here.

off.title: The wiki feature isn't available
off.body: The wiki feature is off, so the rule list can't load.

editor.readonly: You can't write to this folder, so you can't edit the rules.
editor.conflictBody: Reloading discards the changes on this screen. Overwriting discards the changes made elsewhere.
editor.savedWithIssues: Saved, but there's something to check.
editor.syntaxHint: If empty, the settings and default syntax apply

delete.title: Delete rule “{name}”?
delete.body: The rule file and its content files are deleted together.
delete.usedBy_one: The rule will show as missing in {count} wiki that uses it (the wiki keeps working)
delete.usedBy_other: The rule will show as missing in {count} wikis that use it (the wikis keep working)
delete.library: Copies already made in projects aren't affected

versions.note: A version is kept each time you save. Reverting rewrites that version's rule and content files.

files.links: Links between the rule and content files
files.instructionsNote: This text is passed on as instructions to agents that have the wiki resource. It's passed as written, so describe the rules in plain sentences.
files.templateNote: Fills in the content when a new page is created.
files.noLinks: No content files are linked to the rule. Add instructions or a page template on the Rules tab.

widgets.globHint: Based on the page path without the extension
widgets.regexHint: Only matching line numbers appear in the issue
widgets.unknownValue: The server doesn't know this value

widget.libraryNote: Wikis live in projects. The wiki id must match the wiki id in the project that copied it.
widget.loadFailed: Couldn't load the wiki list, so enter the id yourself.

runChanges.label: Wiki pages edited
runChanges.tip: View the pages this run wrote to the wiki
runChanges.listLabel: Wiki pages edited by this run
runChanges.deletedTip: Deleted page — you can restore it from history

fromMemory.noWiki: This project has no wiki. Create one on the Wiki screen first.
fromMemory.note: Creates a copy of the memory entry. It isn't linked to the memory entry.

editorLib.conflictBody: Saving replaces the changed content. Load the server version first, or overwrite with your changes.
editorLib.externalBody: This page was changed elsewhere. Saving causes a conflict.
editorLib.missingBody: The file {file} is gone. The app doesn't create files for you.
